title: Sheafified presentation of modules of differentials
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a morphism of presheaves of commutative rings. The module of differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] $\Omega_{\mathcal B^#/\mathcal A^#}$ of the sheafified ring map is canonically the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $U\mapsto\Omega_{\mathcal B(U)/\mathcal A(U)}$, and the identification carries the sectionwise universal derivations to the sheaf universal derivation. Equivalently, both are the cokernel of the sheafified free-module relation map encoding additivity, Leibniz, and annihilation of $\mathcal A$ in the category of sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].
